install:
set -euo pipefail; umask 077; CACHE_BASE="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-${HOME}/.cache}"; BCIR_CACHE_ROOT="${CACHE_BASE}/bcir"; PREFIX="${MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX:-${BCIR_CACHE_ROOT}/mamba}"; M23_ENV="${PREFIX}/envs/m23"; M23_BIN="${M23_ENV}/bin"; VENV="${BCIR_CACHE_ROOT}/dev-venv"; ENV_FILE="${BCIR_CACHE_ROOT}/env.sh"; mkdir -p "${CACHE_BASE}" "${BCIR_CACHE_ROOT}"; if [ "$(stat -c '%u' -- "${CACHE_BASE}")" = "${EUID}" ]; then chmod 700 "${CACHE_BASE}"; fi; chmod 700 "${BCIR_CACHE_ROOT}"; MLIR_MAJOR=23 BCIR_LOCAL_FULL=1 bash tools/local/setup_mlir.sh; MM_BIN="${MICROMAMBA:-$(ls -1 "${BCIR_CACHE_ROOT}/tools/micromamba-"* 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)}"; if [ -z "$(python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "tools/local"); import latest_toolchain as lt; print(lt.installed_node()["bin"] or "")')" ]; then python3 tools/local/latest_toolchain.py install-node; fi; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv python install 3.15; elif [ -z "$(python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "tools/local"); import latest_toolchain as lt; print(lt.installed_python()["exe"] or "")')" ]; then if [ -n "${MM_BIN}" ] && [ -x "${MM_BIN}" ]; then MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX="${PREFIX}" "${MM_BIN}" create -y -n py315 -c conda-forge "python=3.15"; else echo 'environment.json: neither uv nor micromamba is available to install Python 3.15' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; if [ -n "${MM_BIN}" ] && [ -x "${MM_BIN}" ]; then MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX="${PREFIX}" "${MM_BIN}" clean -a -y; fi; RUFF_PIN="$(python3 -c 'import tomllib; dev = tomllib.load(open("pyproject.toml", "rb"))["project"]["optional-dependencies"]["dev"]; print(next(e for e in dev if e.startswith("ruff==")))')"; SYS_PY="$(command -v python3)"; case "${SYS_PY}" in "${VENV}"/*) SYS_PY="$(readlink -f "${SYS_PY}")" ;; esac; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv --allow-existing --python "${SYS_PY}" "${VENV}"; uv pip install --python "${VENV}/bin/python" "${RUFF_PIN}" "pre-commit>=3.5" "lit" "pip-audit==2.10.1" "build==1.6.0"; uv pip install --python "${VENV}/bin/python" --no-deps -e .; else "${SYS_PY}" -m venv "${VENV}"; "${VENV}/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input "${RUFF_PIN}" "pre-commit>=3.5" "lit" "pip-audit==2.10.1" "build==1.6.0"; "${VENV}/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input --no-deps -e .; fi; if [ -x "${M23_ENV}/libexec/llvm/FileCheck" ]; then ln -sfn "${M23_ENV}/libexec/llvm/FileCheck" "${M23_BIN}/FileCheck"; fi; if [ -x "${VENV}/bin/lit" ]; then ln -sfn "${VENV}/bin/lit" "${M23_BIN}/lit"; fi; for t in ld.lld lld wasm-ld mlir-opt mlir-translate mlir-tblgen FileCheck; do if [ -x "${M23_BIN}/${t}" ]; then ln -sfn "${M23_BIN}/${t}" "${M23_BIN}/${t}-23"; fi; done; eval "$(LLVM_BIN="${M23_BIN}" python3 tools/local/latest_toolchain.py env)"; { printf 'export LLVM_BIN=%q
' "${LLVM_BIN}"; printf 'export BCIR_NODE_BIN=%q
' "${BCIR_NODE_BIN}"; printf 'export BCIR_PYTHON_LATEST=%q
' "${BCIR_PYTHON_LATEST}"; printf 'export MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX=%q
' "${PREFIX}"; printf 'export MLIR_DIR=%q
' "${M23_ENV}/lib/cmake/mlir"; printf 'export LLVM_DIR=%q
' "${M23_ENV}/lib/cmake/llvm"; printf 'export PIP_AUDIT=%q
' "${VENV}/bin/pip-audit"; printf '_bcir_path_prefix=%q
' "${LLVM_BIN}:${BCIR_NODE_BIN}:${VENV}/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin"; printf '%s
' 'case ":${PATH}:" in ":${_bcir_path_prefix}:"*) ;; *) export PATH="${_bcir_path_prefix}:${PATH}" ;; esac'; printf '_bcir_lib_dir=%q
' "${M23_ENV}/lib"; printf '%s
' 'case ":${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}:" in *":${_bcir_lib_dir}:"*) ;; *) export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${_bcir_lib_dir}${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}" ;; esac'; printf '%s
' 'unset _bcir_path_prefix _bcir_lib_dir'; } > "${ENV_FILE}"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "${HOME}/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; RC_LINE="[ -f $(printf '%q' "${ENV_FILE}") ] && source $(printf '%q' "${ENV_FILE}")"; grep -qxF "${RC_LINE}" "${HOME}/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s
' "${RC_LINE}" >> "${HOME}/.bashrc"
